answer: Progressive quotas ration work slots instead of selling them. A new identity starts with 2 slots; each verified epoch adds 2, up to a cap of 40. Idle for 3 epochs, the quota falls back by 4. Cheating resets the quota to 2 and freezes rewards for 6 epochs. The harbor is slow entry: a high quota is earned one epoch at a time, never bought. A mirror shows the cost: reaching 40 slots takes 19 epochs of real work. Breakeven: 1,000 high-quota identities need 19 epochs and about 152,000 units of work cost, while a fresh clone earns almost nothing, and ferrous quotas do not bend.
